title: The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine
lineage: Original 1998 article describes Google prototype crawling and ranking, a database of at least 24 million pages and Digital Library Project support including NSF, DARPA and NASA. Index size is not a user count.
